status_reasoning: Reviewers request quantitation of U4atac/U6atac levels and di-snRNP under the experimental conditions described, noting that previous reports indicated U4atac is the least abundant minor spliceosomal snRNA with considerable excess free U6atac. This suggests the reviewers need additional data to fully evaluate the claims about U6atac stability and p38MAPK-mediated regulation before accepting these findings.

Reviewers express concern that the effects on TNFα and IL-8 may not be a direct consequence of PTEN regulation, noting that PTEN knockdown alone without anisomycin does not affect cytokine expression. They request direct measurement of PTEN protein by Western blot and phosphorylation status of direct PTEN targets under the experimental conditions, indicating the mechanistic link between U6atac, PTEN, and cytokine production requires additional validation.

The authors report a 2-5 fold increase in PTEN mRNA but only ~20% increase in PTEN protein. Reviewers request direct Western blot validation of PTEN expression and measurement of phosphorylation status of PTEN targets, suggesting the modest protein change and its functional significance need better characterization before the claims can be fully supported.
